title: Who may see it
sub: The fourth film of a series on data governance: a planner asks for learner data, and the line a court drew in 1983 runs between columns. Classify once, at the column, and protect it everywhere.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms and in West Germany in 1983. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Plum is direct personal data, a paler plum pseudonymous, plain paper none; a mask is a plum band of stars. Gold is governance's decisions.
